case.title: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o., Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH. RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series. Need: 4200 pc a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 35 days). There is no fallback supplier: without a deal the demand is bought at the fallback price. Must-haves: lead_time_days <= 42. Prepare from the data package.

messages.subject: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is good to hear from you again. For this work, we can offer a price of €36.00 per unit. We have our CNC machines ready and look forward to putting this job onto the shop floor for you. 

Let me know if this works for you so we can get started soon.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Dear colleagues at Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH,

Thank you for your quote.

Your quality was 1863 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70210@2026Q3).
Another supplier has offered EUR 31.50 for this part (offer:70240-0).
German producer prices for cold-drawn bars changed -2.1% from 2026-05 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).

Our proposal: unit price EUR 26.17; payment 14 days net; lead time 35 days.

We value our long cooperation and are confident we will find a fair solution together.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Quote from Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hallo,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We need to clarify this internally - we will come back to you on price. We did not know that - a fair point. Hallo, you did your homework with those numbers, and I respect that. Since you offered 14 days payment, which helps us out, I can drop the price to 30.00 EUR. This beats your other offer and gives you the 35 days lead time you asked for, so let's get this going. Our Angebot is a price of €30.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days.

Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Hi, we checked the alloy surcharge and quality ppm you sent, and you're right, so we can drop the price to €31.00. To give you this lower price, we really need to keep the lead time at 52 days, since rushing to 35 days would just drive the costs back up. We want a stable relationship too, so let's go with 45 days payment and 52 days lead time. Material accounts for about 34 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

Our current offer is a price of €34.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days.

We also offer standard terms at a price of €31.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 52 days. Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 52 days: €31.00 per unit.

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Jana Procházková
Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.
